name: OrganizationMembership
description: AUTHORITATIVE SOURCE for organization access. Links users to organizations with verified roles. NO entity may bypass this table for org claims.

fields.name: verified_at
fields.description: Timestamp when membership was verified by owner/admin or domain. NULL = unverified.

fields.name: pilot_enrollment
fields.description: True if created via open pilot signup

fields.name: invited_by
fields.description: User ID who sent the invitation (if applicable)

indexes.name: idx_orgmembership_active
indexes.description: Fast lookup of verified active memberships

policies.name: Users can view their own memberships
Admins can manage memberships for their org
policies.check: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM OrganizationMembership WHERE organization_id = OrganizationMembership.organization_id AND user_id = auth.uid() AND role IN ('owner', 'admin') AND status = 'active' AND verified_at IS NOT NULL)
